title: PRIME: Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling Enhancement for Structured Document Retrieval-Real
title_zh: PRIME：结构化文档检索增强预检索索引建模（适用于真实场景）

paragraphs.en: High-precision retrieval over external knowledge bases is essential for LLM agents to operate effectively. However, existing Information Retrieval (IR) research primarily optimizes query-side retrievers (e.g., ColBERT, BGE) and generators (e.g., Self-RAG, GraphRAG), while reducing corpus-side representation to chunking. This leaves index-side quality an underexplored lever. We propose Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling & Enhancement (PRIME), an index-side optimization framework built on two complementary tracks: an LLM-driven Semantic Restructuring (SR) track that transforms long documents into structured, information-dense sections, and a deterministic Metadata Synthesis (MS) and Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) track that extracts semantic anchors and heading structure for coarse-to-fine section retrieval. Our evaluations show that deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking’s retrieval quality while cutting embedding computation by 45.8× and index vector count by 22.4×. On top of these gains, Semantic Restructuring (SR) further improves Answer-F1 by 13.7% in full deployment, with characterized quality–fidelity–cost trade-offs. Across QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we further characterize three qualitative regimes that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, while showing that these index-side effects are neutralized under a strong reranker.
paragraphs.zh: 在外部知识库中进行高精度检索，对于大型语言模型智能体（LLM agents）的有效运行至关重要。 然而，现有的信息检索（IR）研究主要优化查询侧的检索器（例如 ColBERT、BGE）和生成器（例如 Self-RAG、GraphRAG），而将语料库侧的表示简化为分块处理。 这使得索引侧的质量成为一个尚未充分探索的优化方向。 我们提出了预检索索引建模与增强框架（Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling & Enhancement, PRIME），这是一个基于两个互补路径的索引侧优化框架：由大型语言模型驱动的语义重构（Semantic Restructuring, SR）路径，可将长文档转化为结构清晰、信息密集的分段；以及确定性的元数据合成（Metadata Synthesis, MS）与分层检索（Hierarchical Retrieval, HR）路径，用于提取语义锚点和标题结构，以实现从粗到细的分段检索。 我们的评估表明，确定性元数据在匹配质量上可与结构感知分块相媲美，同时将嵌入计算量减少了 45.8 倍，索引向量数量减少了 22.4 倍。 在这些改进的基础上，语义重构（SR）在完整部署中进一步将 Answer-F1 提升了 13.7%，并呈现出质量、保真度与成本之间的明确权衡关系。 在 QASPER、BRIGHT 和 NFCorpus 数据集上，我们进一步识别出三种定性状态，这些状态决定了索引侧优化是提升还是降低检索效果；同时我们发现，在强重排序器作用下，这些索引侧的影响会被中和。

paragraphs.en: Efficient information retrieval (IR) is essential for LLM agents, as the quality of retrieved contexts serves as the foundational bottleneck for downstream generation ( Guu et al. 2020 ; Lewis et al. 2020 ; Borgeaud et al. 2022 ; Izacard et al. 2023 ) . While query-side retrievers and generators have been extensively refined—from sparse models ( Robertson and Zaragoza 2009 ) to dense dual-encoders ( Karpukhin et al. 2020 ) , late-interaction frameworks ( Khattab and Zaharia 2020 ) , and cross-encoder rerankers—corpus-side representation has largely remained a fixed input. Conventional preprocessing merely alters text without enhancing its information density or logical structure.
paragraphs.zh: 高效的信息检索（IR）对大型语言模型智能体至关重要，因为检索到的上下文质量构成了下游生成任务的基础性瓶颈（Guu 等，2020；Lewis 等，2020；Borgeaud 等，2022；Izacard 等，2023）。 尽管查询侧的检索器和生成器已经得到了广泛优化——从稀疏模型（Robertson 和 Zaragoza，2009）到密集双编码器（Karpukhin 等，2020）、晚期交互框架（Khattab 和 Zaharia，2020）以及跨编码器重排序器——但语料库侧的表示在很大程度上仍然是一个固定输入。 传统的预处理方法仅仅改变文本，而无法提升其信息密度或逻辑结构。

paragraphs.en: We propose that retrieval quality is bounded by the information density of the indexed corpus. Once a strong retriever and reranker are in place, the remaining leverage lies in information structure and density at the index level. Guided by this principle, we present PRIME, an index-side quality optimization framework that operates on two complementary tracks without modifying the retriever. Semantic Restructuring (SR) employs an LLM-driven transformation to explicate implicit argument structure and compress descriptive prose within each section, increasing knowledge density for long structured documents. In parallel, Metadata Synthesis (MS) and Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) form a fully deterministic track: MS extracts semantic anchors and heading structure from the original document, which HR then consumes with lightweight high-density embeddings for coarse document filtering and a cross-encoder for fine-grained section reranking. Figure 1 situates PRIME in the retrieval landscape.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出，检索质量受索引语料库的信息密度所限制。 一旦部署了强大的检索器和重排序器，剩余的提升空间就取决于索引层的信息结构和密度。 基于这一原则，我们提出了 PRIME——一个在索引端进行质量优化的框架，它通过两条互补的路径运行，且无需修改检索器。 语义重构（SR）采用由大语言模型驱动的转变方式，以阐明隐性的论证结构并压缩各部分中的描述性文本，从而提升长结构化文档的知识密度。 与此同时，元数据合成（MS）和层次化检索（HR）构成了一条完全确定性的路径：MS 从原始文档中提取语义锚点和标题结构，随后 HR 利用轻量级的高密度嵌入进行粗略的文档过滤，并使用交叉编码器对各个部分进行精细的重排序。 图 1 展示了 PRIME 在检索体系中的定位。

paragraphs.en: Deterministic structural metadata matches structure-aware chunking’s retrieval quality while cutting embedding computation by 45.8× and index vector count by 22.4×, establishing a more efficient and lightweight alternative to LLM-mediated indexing.
paragraphs.zh: 确定性结构元数据在匹配结构感知分块的检索质量的同时，将嵌入计算量减少了 45.8 倍，索引向量数量减少了 22.4 倍，从而为基于大型语言模型（LLM）的索引方法提供了一种更高效、更轻量化的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: On top of these deterministic gains, Semantic Restructuring (SR) further yields an additional +13.7% Answer-F1 in full deployment, with characterized semantic quality, fidelity, and cost trade-offs.
paragraphs.zh: 除了这些确定性的收益之外，语义重构（Semantic Restructuring，SR）在全面部署中还能进一步提升 Answer-F1 指标 +13.7%，同时具备明确的语义质量、保真度和成本之间的权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: Through a 5 × \times 3 factorial ablation on QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we identify three corpus regimes,deficit-bridging, structural exploitation, and structural saturation,that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, and show that a strong cross-encoder reranker neutralizes these gains.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对 QASPER、BRIGHT 和 NFCorpus 进行 5 × \times 3 的因子消融实验，我们识别出三种语料库机制：缺陷弥合、结构利用和结构饱和。这些机制决定了索引侧优化是有助于检索还是降低检索效果，并表明一个强大的跨编码器重排序器能够抵消这些增益。

paragraphs.en: Query-side retrieval has been extensively optimized. From sparse retrieval ( Robertson and Zaragoza 2009 ) to learned sparse representations such as SPLADE ( Formal et al. 2021 ) . Dense retrieval progressed through dual-encoder architectures including DPR ( Karpukhin et al. 2020 ) , ANCE ( Xiong et al. 2021 ) and Contriever ( Izacard et al. 2021 ) , multi-vector late-interaction models represented by ColBERT ( Khattab and Zaharia 2020 ) , and multilingual general-purpose encoders like BGE-M3 ( Xiao et al. 2024 ) . Multi-stage refinement adds cross-encoder rerankers ( Nogueira and Cho 2019 ) and LLM-based listwise ranking approaches such as RankGPT ( Sun et al. 2023 ) . On the query formulation side, methods including HyDE ( Gao et al. 2023 ) expand queries via hypothetical passages. However, these methods optimize how queries are encoded, matched, and ranked against a fixed document representation.
paragraphs.zh: 查询侧的检索技术已经得到了广泛优化。 从稀疏检索（Robertson 和 Zaragoza，2009）到像 SPLADE（Formal 等，2021）这样的学习型稀疏表示。 密集检索的发展经历了双编码器架构，包括 DPR（Karpukhin 等，2020）、ANCE（Xiong 等，2021）和 Contriever（Izacard 等，2021）；以 ColBERT（Khattab 和 Zaharia，2020）为代表的多向量晚期交互模型；以及像 BGE-M3（Xiao 等，2024）这样的多语言通用编码器。 多阶段优化加入了跨编码器重排序器（Nogueira 和 Cho，2019），以及基于 LLM 的列表式排名方法，例如 RankGPT（Sun 等，2023）。 在查询构建方面，包括 HyDE（Gao 等，2023）在内的方法通过假设性段落来扩展查询。 然而，这些方法优化的是如何将查询编码、匹配以及与固定的文档表示进行排名。

paragraphs.en: On Corpus-Side, several lines of work have modified the corpus before indexing. Early document preprocessing techniques ( Manning 2008 ) adjust surface token forms. Early structured document retrieval ( Wilkinson 1994 ) exploited pre-existing field markup for weighted term scoring but relied on author-provided structure. Extractive summarization for IR ( Tombros and Sanderson 1998 ) selects a subset of existing sentences and trades recall for conciseness without generating new, denser text. Document expansion via query prediction such as Doc2Query ( Nogueira et al. 2019 ) , appends synthetic queries to broaden lexical coverage for term matching, yet leaves the document’s original knowledge content and information density unchanged. Chunking strategies ( Bhat et al. 2025 ) determine where to place segment boundaries but preserve the token composition within each segment. Across these approaches, a common pattern emerges: each modifies how text is packaged, not what the text conveys.
paragraphs.zh: 在语料库处理阶段，有几项工作在对语料库进行索引前对其进行了修改。 早期的文档预处理技术（Manning 2008）会调整表层词元形式。 早期的结构化文档检索方法（Wilkinson 1994）利用了预先存在的字段标记来进行加权术语评分，但依赖于作者提供的结构。 用于信息检索的抽取式摘要（Tombros and Sanderson 1998）会选择现有句子中的一个子集，以简洁性为代价牺牲召回率，而不会生成新的、更密集的文字内容。 通过查询预测实现的文档扩展方法，例如 Doc2Query（Nogueira et al. 2019），会附加合成查询以扩大词汇覆盖范围，便于术语匹配，但并未改变文档原有的知识内容和信息密度。 分块策略（Bhat et al. 2025）决定了分段边界的放置位置，但保留了每个分段内部的词元构成。 在这些方法中，出现了一个共同的模式：每种方法都改变了文本的包装方式，而非文本所传达的内容本身。

paragraphs.en: Index-Side Restructuring: Recent Progress and Remaining Gap. Recent methods have begun exploiting document structure for indexing. Multi-view Content-aware Indexing ( Dong et al. 2024 ) , DISRetrieval ( Chen et al. 2026b ) , and PaperRegister ( Wang et al. 2026 ) organize documents by content structure, discourse, or register but derive representations from original tokens without transformation. Summary-Augmented Chunking ( Reuter et al. 2025 ) injects document-level context into chunks, improving retrieval without rewriting the indexed text. RAPTOR ( Sarthi et al. 2024 ) generates recursive LLM summaries but relies on embedding-driven clustering. GraphRAG ( Edge et al. 2024 ) and follow-up graph-based methods such as PathRAG ( Chen et al. 2026a ) and LeanRAG ( Zhang et al. 2026 ) reorganize at the graph level without modifying indexed text. Across these methods, structure is exploited but text is not transformed; text is enriched but its information density is not increased. Singh et al. (2026) add a critical constraint: once a strong cross-encoder reranker is present, retrieval enhancements yield no Holm-corrected gain. PRIME occupies the resulting gap; generative text restructuring that increases information density (SR), combined with deterministic metadata extraction (MS) and structure-aware hierarchical retrieval (HR), with characterized boundary conditions.

paragraphs.en: SR transforms each document D i D_{i} into a knowledge-dense representation D i ∗ D_{i}^{*} while preserving the original H2 structure. It operates along two semantic axes: Explication reconstructs implicit argumentative structures within each H2 section into declarative statements, and Compression eliminates descriptive prose while retaining core contributions, conclusions, key terms, and numerical results. By removing low-IDF filler tokens, SR shifts D i ∗ D_{i}^{*} toward high-IDF discriminative terms, so the cross-encoder’s pairwise attention operates on a denser semantic signal per token and the LLM generator consumes fewer tokens for the same answer-relevant content.

paragraphs.en: The Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) module consumes MS-generated metadata through a two-stage pipeline: coarse document filtering followed by section-level reranking. This design reflects the observation that document-level relevance can be assessed via coarse semantic signals, while section-level relevance requires fine-grained token interaction.

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 retrieves candidate documents using two parallel pathways. The BM25 pathway indexes the full document text for exact keyword matches. The vector pathway indexes the high-density metadata (title + discriminative terms + heading tree) encoded via BGE-small-en-v1.5 (384-dim; Xiao et al., 2024). Results from both pathways are merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k = 60 k=60 ) ( Cormack et al. 2009 ) to form a top-30 candidate set. The heading tree is invariant to whether SR is applied (H2 structure is preserved). In PRIME (offline), discriminative terms are extracted from D i D_{i} . In full PRIME, terms are extracted from D i ∗ D_{i}^{*} , reflecting SR’s vocabulary shift; the resulting impact is quantified in the Ablation.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on three structurally diverse benchmarks: QASPER ( Dasigi et al. 2021 ) serves as the target scenario for PRIME’s full pipeline: we use 416 papers from the official test set, producing 1,451 queries with document-level qrels (one relevant document per query, 415 negatives). Queries are natural language questions without title or metadata. BRIGHT ( SU et al. 2025 ) tests cross-domain generalization of PRIME’s offline mode across mixed-structure sources. We evaluate all twelve subsets despite four (AoPS, LeetCode, TheoremQA-Q, and TheoremQA-Theorems) requiring reasoning which fall outside PRIME’s design scope. NFCorpus ( Boteva et al. 2016 ) , from the BEIR benchmark ( Thakur et al. 2021 ) , defines the boundary condition where structural metadata provides no discriminative signal.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个结构各异的基准数据集上进行评估：QASPER（Dasigi 等人，2021）作为 PRIME 完整流程的目标场景；我们使用官方测试集中的 416 篇论文，生成了 1,451 条查询，每条查询都带有文档级别的 qrels（每个查询一个相关文档和 415 个无关文档）。 这些查询是自然语言问题，不包含标题或元数据。 BRIGHT（SU 等人，2025）测试了 PRIME 离线模式在混合结构来源上的跨域泛化能力。 尽管有四个子集（AoPS、LeetCode、TheoremQA-Q 和 TheoremQA-Theorems）需要推理能力，而这类任务超出了 PRIME 的设计范围，我们仍然对这十二个子集全部进行了评估。 NFCorpus（Boteva 等人，2016）来自 BEIR 基准数据集（Thakur 等人，2021），它定义了一种边界情况：即结构性元数据无法提供任何区分性信息。

paragraphs.en: Index-side optimization improves retrieval, but its measurable advantage narrows as downstream pipeline components increasingly compensate for weaker embeddings. We establish this through two complementary analyses: a shared-pipeline ceiling that reveals convergence under a strong reranker (Table 1), and a factorial decomposition that isolates index representation from pipeline effects (Table 2).
paragraphs.zh: 索引侧的优化能提升检索效果，但随着下游流程组件对较弱嵌入表示的补偿作用日益增强，其可量化的优势会逐渐缩小。 我们通过两种互补的分析方法证实了这一点：一种是通过共享流程的上限分析，揭示了在强重排序器作用下性能会趋于收敛（表1）；另一种是因子分解分析，将索引表示与流程效应分离开来（表2）。

paragraphs.en: All six methods converge within NDCG@5 = 0.389–0.398, echoing the reranker-saturation effect reported by Singh et al. (2026) : once a strong cross-encoder is in the loop, corpus-side differences become nearly inseparable. This apparent equivalence conflates index quality with pipeline strength. We therefore evaluate a 5 × 3 5\times 3 factorial matrix varying only the indexed text representation across three pipelines (Dense-only, Hybrid BM25+RRF, Hybrid+CE), disentangling the two. 95% paired bootstrap CIs (10,000 resamples) are reported.

paragraphs.en: Within this narrowing gap, structured representations exhibit distinct efficiency trade-offs: Deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking at a fraction of the cost . Structure-chunks and PRIME (offline) remain indistinguishable (overlapping 95% CIs). Yet, PRIME (offline) embeds only metadata while capturing the same document-filtering signal as full-text chunking, at 45.8× less embedding computation and 22.4× fewer indexed vectors (Operational Cost). In contrast, both SR-based representations trade lexical signal for semantic density . PRIME (Full) achieves the highest Dense-only NDCG@5 (0.214), confirming that the compact metadata embedding (title, topic tags, and heading tree extracted from SR text, ~200 tokens) already captures stronger discriminative signal than raw chunk-256. However, BM25—common to both SR (full-text) and PRIME (Full) via the same SR body index—drops substantially below Raw in the Hybrid pipeline (0.241 and 0.245 vs. 0.311), because rewriting shifts text toward high-IDF terms at the expense of surface keyword overlap. CE reranking partially recovers this loss (Hybrid+CE: 0.325 and 0.328), though this retrieval-side cost is ultimately offset by improved context quality during generation (Context Quality).
paragraphs.zh: 在这一不断缩小的差距中，结构化表示展现出明显的效率权衡：确定性元数据匹配在成本仅为结构感知分块一小部分的情况下实现了类似效果。 结构分块与 PRIME（离线）版本仍无法区分（95% 置信区间重叠）。 然而，PRIME（离线）仅嵌入元数据，却能捕捉到与全文分块相同的文档过滤信号，其嵌入计算量减少了 45.8 倍，索引向量数量也减少了 22.4 倍（运营成本）。 相比之下，两种基于 SR 的表示都以牺牲词汇信号为代价换取了更高的语义密度。 PRIME（完整）实现了最高的纯密集 NDCG@5（0.214），证实了紧凑的元数据嵌入（从 SR 文本中提取的标题、主题标签和标题树，约 200 个词元）已比原始分块-256 捕捉到了更强的区分性信号。 然而，BM25——通过相同的 SR 主体索引同时用于 SR（全文）和 PRIME（完整）——在混合流程中的得分显著低于原始版本（分别为 0.241 和 0.245，而原始为 0.311），因为改写过程使文本更偏向高 IDF 的术语，但牺牲了表层关键词的重叠度。 CE 重排序部分恢复了这一损失（混合+CE：0.325 和 0.328），尽管这种检索端的成本最终被生成过程中上下文质量的提升所抵消（上下文质量）。

paragraphs.en: The Δ \Delta distribution across the eight structured tasks falls into three qualitative regimes, each predicted by corpus properties that can be assessed before retrieval. At one extreme, deficit-bridging (pony, +175.6%): dense API reference documentation is poorly represented by BGE-small’s pretraining distribution, so the discriminative terms by MS serve as a natural-language bridge for the encoder. Typical structured documents earn modest gains from structure-exploiting (biology to economics, +4.6% to +22.3%), where structured H2 sections with [edit] wiki markers anchor CE section reranking. At the opposite end, structure-absent or saturated domains (sustainable_living to earth_science, -3.1% to -23.1%) show that prose already well-embedded by BGE-small, with sparse or empty heading trees, receives no additional discriminative signal from metadata. TheoremQA-Theorems (-59.8%, excluded from the average) marks a distinct fourth mode rather than saturation: its LaTeX blocks are parsed as H2 sections but fragment mathematical proofs and requires reasoning, so the CE scores an isolated definition against a query that requires a complete inferential chain.
paragraphs.zh: 八项结构化任务中的 Δ \Delta 分布可分为三种定性状态，每种状态都可通过在检索前评估的语料库属性进行预测。 在一端，存在“缺陷弥合”现象（pony，+175.6%）：密集型的 API 参考文档在 BGE-small 的预训练分布中代表性不足，因此 MS 提供的区分性术语充当了编码器的自然语言桥梁。 典型结构化文档通过利用结构特征的方法获得了适度提升（从生物学到经济学，+4.6% 至 +22.3%），其中带有 [edit] wiki 标记的结构化 H2 部分为 CE 的段落重排序提供了锚点。 在另一端，缺乏结构或结构饱和的领域（从 sustainable_living 到 earth_science，-3.1% 至 -23.1%）表明，对于 BGE-small 已充分嵌入、且标题树稀疏或为空的文章文本，元数据无法提供额外的区分性信号。 TheoremQA-Theorems（-59.8%，未计入平均值）代表了一种独特的第四种模式，而非饱和状态：其 LaTeX 块被解析为 H2 部分，但会碎片化数学证明并要求推理，因此 CE 仅能对一条需要完整推理链的查询匹配到一个孤立的定义。

Yes/no queries are excluded (2 queries with evidence-bearing sections). Full derivation of density metrics in Appendix D.5, full evidence retrieval metrics in Appendix D.7.

paragraphs.en: Finally, we quantify SR’s end-to-end QA impact, denoting configurations as retrieval corpus to generation corpus. All configurations share the same full-body hybrid retrieval pipeline, differing only in whether the raw or SR corpus being indexed and read. Raw to Raw yields a baseline Answer-F1 of 0.0842. Raw to SR adds +2.9% (0.0866), isolating SR’s value as denser reading material. Full to Full reaches 0.0957 (+13.7%), despite its document-level retrieval being substantially weaker (demonstrated in Table 2). The gap between Raw to SR and Full to Full shows that SR benefits QA primarily through improved cross-encoder evidence localization on denser sections, which more than compensates for the document-level retrieval drop.

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these three audits define the quality-fidelity profile of SR. For roughly 60% of documents, SR delivers substantially denser text at negligible factual cost. For the remaining documents, the primary risk is omission under compression, not fabrication. Therefore, SR is best suited to declarative, evidence-dense documents while domains rich in procedural reasoning or formal logic require caution.

paragraphs.en: Our results reveal that index-side optimization is effective at the context level. However, the fact that deterministic metadata matches structured chunking while SR’s QA gains flow primarily through improved retrieval rather than context substitution points to a broader issue: retrieval metrics alone are an incomplete lens on corpus-side preprocessing. Additionally, the three-regime pattern across BRIGHT points to a broader implication. Index-side interventions are not universally beneficial, their utility is predictable from corpus properties measurable before retrieval. This shifts the evaluation focus from absolute improvement to corpus-conditioned utility, precisely the dimension that standard IR benchmarks, averaged over heterogeneous corpora, cannot resolve. Four open problems follow. SR’s quality-fidelity trade-off raises the question of when rewriting can be trusted without verification; its break-even cost (Operational Cost) motivates lighter restructuring strategies without losing information; the interference on heading-free corpora (Retrieval Quality, NFCorpus) suggests corpus-adaptive strategies; and our text-only pipeline is inherently limited to textual evidence — table and figure content in QASPER is not indexed. These call for a principled theory of index-side optimization conditioned on document structure, rather than empirical heuristics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，索引侧的优化在上下文层面是有效的。 然而，确定性元数据与结构化分块相匹配，而 SR 的问答性能提升主要源于检索能力的增强而非上下文替换这一事实，指向了一个更广泛的问题：仅凭检索指标无法全面反映语料库侧预处理的效果。 此外，BRIGHT 中呈现的三种模式也揭示了一个更广泛的含义。 索引侧的干预措施并非普遍有益，其效用可以通过在检索前测量的语料库特性进行预测。 这将评估的重点从绝对改进转向了依赖于语料库条件的效用，而这正是标准信息检索基准（基于异质语料库的平均结果）无法解决的问题维度。 由此引申出四个开放性问题。 SR 在质量与保真度之间的权衡引发了一个问题：在何种情况下可以信任改写而无需验证；其盈亏平衡成本（操作成本）促使我们采用更轻量化的重构策略以避免信息丢失；在无标题语料库中观察到的干扰（检索质量，NFCorpus）表明需要采用适应语料库的策略；此外，我们的纯文本流程本质上仅限于文本证据——QASPER 中的表格和图表内容并未被索引。 这些问题要求我们建立一种基于文档结构的、有原则的索引侧优化理论，而非依赖经验性启发式方法。

paragraphs.en: We presented PRIME, an index-side optimization framework combining LLM-driven Semantic Restructuring with deterministic Metadata Synthesis and Hierarchical Retrieval. Deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking at 45.8× less embedding computation and 22.4× fewer indexed vectors. On top of these gains, Semantic Restructuring further improves Answer-F1 by 13.7% in full deployment, with characterized quality–fidelity–cost trade-offs. Through extensive evaluation, we identified the operating conditions and cost profiles of this framework. Future work includes improving SR fidelity under text restructuring in order to fulfill its retrieval potential.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PRIME，一个索引端优化框架，它将 LLM 驱动的语义重构与确定性元数据合成及分层检索相结合。 确定性元数据匹配结构感知分块方法，在嵌入计算量上减少了 45.8 倍，在索引向量数量上减少了 22.4 倍。 在这些优势的基础上，语义重构在完整部署中进一步将 Answer-F1 提升了 13.7%，同时呈现出明确的质量–保真度–成本权衡关系。 通过广泛评估，我们确定了该框架的运行条件和成本特征。 未来的工作包括提升文本重构下 SR 的保真度，以充分发挥其检索潜力。
